headline: Image in a Chris Abele ad shows lake that's supposedly created by Estabrook Dam
claim: An image in a Chris Abele TV ad depicts "wealthy citizens" who would benefit from a "lake" created by the controversial Estabrook Dam.

headline: Bruce Starr claims to be the only state senator to vote for stronger ethics laws
claim: Bruce Starr was the only senator to vote for stronger ethics laws and greater accountability.

headline: David Jolly says 'Social Security is not guaranteed,' according to the Supreme Court
claim: Says the U.S. Supreme Court found that "Social Security is not guaranteed."

headline: Barack Obama says taxes on families are at their lowest point in 50 years
claim: "Taxes are lower on families than they've been probably in the last 50 years."

headline: Ron Johnson says Republican budget proposals don’t cut spending, just reduce budget growth
claim: "Nobody in total is proposing cutting anything. We’re trying to reduce the rate of growth in government."

headline: McCain often absent on children's issues
claim: "The Children's Defense Fund rated McCain as the worst senator in Congress for children."

headline: Could City of Portland have saved itself the cost of building the $138 million Powell Butte reservoir?
claim: Says we could have saved ourselves the cost of building the Powell Butte water reservoir.

headline: Gov. Scott Walker says local public unions rushed through contracts without employee contributions for pensions and health care
claim: "We've seen local union after local union rush to their school boards, their city councils, their technical school boards and rush through contracts in the past two weeks that had no contributions to the pension and no contribution to health care."

headline: Ann Marie Buerkle, GOP candidate, says under new health law, feds will track Americans' body mass index
claim: "The Obama Health and Human Services Department is planning to compile a federal health record on all U.S. citizens by 2014," including "each individual’s Body Mass Index."

headline: Did Rep. Kurt Schrader flip flop on whether folks could keep their insurance under Obamacare?
claim: On whether people can keep their insurance under the Affordable Care Act.

headline: Chain e-mail claims Obama is first president to "terminate America’s ability to put a man in space"
claim: Barack Obama is the "First President to terminate America’s ability to put a man in space."

headline: U.S. Rep. Connie Mack said he wouldn't run for U.S. Senate — now adviser says he's in
claim: On whether he would run for U.S. Senate in 2012.

headline: Greg Abbott says 22 times Barack Obama said he couldn't shield immigrants, then said 'I changed law'
claim: "22 times Barack Obama said he did not have the authority to implement this type of" anti-deportation "measure. And then the day after he signed this into law, he said, quote, ‘I just changed the law.’"

headline: Jim Sensenbrenner says under proposed Obama budget, Army would be smaller than before Pearl Harbor
claim: President Barack Obama’s budget threatens national security by proposing "an Army of fewer personnel than we had before Pearl Harbor."

headline: Christie says neighbors of San Bernardino shooters knew more than they did
claim: Neighbors of the San Bernardino shooters "knew that they were talking about trying to take our country and attack it."

headline: Tweets and bloggers say Obama used government shutdown to close Amber Alert system
claim: The Obama administration shut down the Amber Alert program because of the government shutdown.

headline: A closer look at a Facebook post on a man's struggle with the Obamacare marketplace
claim: Says a man opted out of Obamacare after the marketplace launched on Oct. 1, 2013, and was informed he owed a $4,000 fine.

headline: Did Mary Nolan secure funding for Milwaukie bridge project?
claim: Says "as Co-Chair of the Joint Ways & Means Committee, I secured the key piece of funding for" the Portland-Milwaukie Light Rail project bridge."

headline: Mitt Romney says 'Obamacare' adds trillions to the deficit
claim: "Obamacare adds trillions to our deficits and to our national debt."

headline: Dem challenger to GOP U.S. Rep. Sean Duffy of Wisconsin says Duffy voted twice to end Medicare
claim: Says GOP U.S. Rep. Sean Duffy of Wisconsin "voted twice to end Medicare."

headline: Ted Nugent says four justices declared Americans have 'no fundamental right to self-defense'
claim: "We’ve got four Supreme Court justices who … signed their name to a declaration that Americans have no fundamental right to self-defense."
